name: Evernote Public

sources.title: Evernote homepage — free signup via accounts.evernote.com/registration; collaboration/sharing features listed

requirements: A free Evernote account (registration at https://accounts.evernote.com/registration; the batch's /signup URL returned 404)
The 'launch asset' is a publicly shared note, not a directory listing — Evernote has no product directory; value comes from a shared public note link
preparation: A note worth sharing publicly (guide, checklist, resource doc) containing the product link
workflow: Register a free account at https://accounts.evernote.com/registration (linked from evernote.com 'Start for free'/'Sign up for free')
Create the note in the Evernote web client (www.evernote.com/client/web)
Use the note's Share option to generate a public link
Verify the link renders without login
watchFor: Evernote's current v11 product emphasizes private/collaborative notes — the durability and indexability of public note links is unverified; treat this as a weak destination
The batch's /signup path 404'd; registration lives on accounts.evernote.com
Do not expect directory traffic — there is no browsable public catalog of notes
countsAsLive: A public share URL for the note loads in a logged-out browser
unknowns: Whether public note links are still offered in the current Evernote client and whether they are indexable by search engines
